title: Acting differently in a library, a playground, or worship
summary: Most children change how they act by place, a library, a playground, or a place of worship, by about 4 years, CDC says.
body: CDC's examples are three settings, and the milestone is fitting conduct to the room. The line is not a finding about any faith, and it is not a rule that one behavior is correct in a library. The publisher's most is 75 percent or more. The materials are not a validated screen. A child who acts alike in every room is not diagnosed on this card.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Years
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Changes behavior based on where she is (place of worship, library, playground)'.
